latestVersion.changelog:
- Added robust documentation in SKILL.md covering setup, configuration, multi-account support, and command usage for managing email via IMAP/SMTP.
- Now supports multiple accounts with easy switching and per-account configuration in a shared `.env`.
- Enhanced security settings, including directory whitelist for attachment access.
- Improved compatibility and provider instructions for Gmail, Outlook, 163.com, and other popular email services.
- Detailed explanations for command-line usage, with options for checking, searching, fetching, marking, and sending emails (including attachments).

raw_record.summary: Read and send email via IMAP/SMTP. Check for new/unread messages, fetch content, search mailboxes, mark as read/unread, and send emails with attachments. Supports multiple accounts. Works with any IMAP/SMTP server including Gmail, Outlook, 163.com, vip.163.com, 126.com, vip.126.com, 188.com, and vip
